<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) suggests about 7 carbon atoms. The formula C₇H₄O₂ (exact mass 120.0211 Da) is the closest match consistent with the observed mass and carbon count, so the molecular formula is C7H4O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H4O2</final_answer>
